from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    # The most common value is the background. Join horizontal runs of the\n    # other marker cells by coloring the cells between consecutive markers.\n    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        markers = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]\n        for left, right in zip(markers, markers[1:]):\n            for c in range(left + 1, right):\n                if row[c] == bg:\n                    out[r][c] = 2\n    return out\n'''
p=progdir/'task-0a3df74b.py'
p.write_text(source)
